title: SEE YOU MARCH 9th @Warriors Musical!!!!! #warriorsmusical #linmanuelm...
transcript: Lin Manuel Miranda and Eisa Davis's new musical, The Warriors is one of my most anticipated shows of the year. I have this very specific memory of driving up to my friend's wedding two years ago. I was in the car with a bunch of my friends, and we put on the album for the first time. I'd never heard it. And we listen to it all the way through. And then we listen to it all the way through again. And I was like, how are they ever, ever, ever, ever going to bring this to Broadway? This feels so grand and massive, and the scale feels insane, and the music was so good. But now we're gonna find out, and I can't wait. I'm obsessed with this new logo. I again love the music And now we have a cast. It's a lot of people who were on the concert album, which is wild. I'm so happy Amber Gray is doing it. It's so good. I would join a girl gang if this was the girl gang. They're amazing. They're so cool. I've never seen the movie, and I feel like I should maybe probably change that before the show. Tickets officially go on sale October 22nd, and the first show is March 9th. I'm saying it now. I would like to be there. Actually, I'd like to be at the invited dress, and anyone wants to invite me. But I will be at the first preview cause I just have to know how it's going to work since I filmed that. I found out there was a fan pre sale that already started and I did jump in because I have to go. I will be there for first preview and I spent redacted amount of money on the tickets cause. Oh boy. But if you don't care about going first preview there are actually a lot of really affordable options. First preview though is mayhem. But that makes sense. That makes sense. I'm excited to be there and I'm excited to talk about it and I'm excited to tell you about it. And Ahhh March 9th.
